annotations.title: Nano Banana 2 image generation and editing

description: Google's image model with conversational edits, sharp text and up to 14 reference images, at 1K, 2K or 4K. Compared with other image tools: premium, and one of the most used right now. Price: from $0.092 per image, charged only on success. Price depends on resolution: 1K $0.092, 2K $0.138, 4K $0.205 (default 1K). One call = one image.

image_input.description: Reference or source image URLs (https), optional

resolution.description: Output resolution; sets the price. Default 1K
